'''Teta's Blade''' was a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] that was once used by [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] may have found it during his quest for the [[Star Forge]] in [[3956 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Teta's Blade was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the weapon was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.
